  Background Information

  This code was written by a first year engineering student and thus the quality of work may reflect that. The following idea is a variation of a pulse oximeter
  that is usable for people of all disabilities with a focus on those whom may be amuptated in areas where a pulse oximeter is not commonably placeable.
  The commonly seen oxi meters are often used on fingers which make sense due to the soft tissue found in fingers and the bottom of the feet for ir and red
  imaging. The purpose of these placements is to allow for the sensor to read the threshold value for the precise number of oxygen in the blood and the
